idea-plugin.name: K8s Pod Env Injector
idea-plugin.description:
K8s Pod Env Injector

Fetches environment variables from a Kubernetes Pod (via kubectl exec) and injects them into Spring Boot Run Configurations automatically.

Features

  • Auto-populate Kube Context, Namespace, Deployment via dropdown
  • Env var whitelist support (empty = inject all, specified = inject only matching keys)
  • Filters out Kubernetes-internal env vars (KUBERNETES_*, *_SERVICE_HOST, etc.)
  • 5-minute TTL cache for fetched env vars
  • Manual env vars in Run Configuration always take priority

Prerequisites

  • kubectl installed and available on the system
  • Kubeconfig configured with cluster access (kubectl config get-contexts should list your clusters)
  • RBAC permissions to list namespaces, deployments, and exec into pods
  • At least one Running pod in the target Deployment

Usage

  1. Open Run Configuration → K8s Pod Env tab
  2. Check Enable K8s Pod Env Injection
  3. Select Kube Context, Namespace, Deployment from dropdowns
  4. (Optional) Set env var whitelist to inject only specific keys
  5. Run your application — pod env vars are injected automatically
